data.name: Murthada
data.gender_notes: Murthada is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who gives generously and kindly to others. The name Murthada carries the meaning “Giver of Generosity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Murthada usually hope their child will grow to embody giver of generosity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Murthada belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver of Generosity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murthada total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مرضى
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الرضا والقبول من الله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: مرضى هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، يعني الرضا والقبول من الله تعالى. وهو مشتق من الفعل 'رضي' الذي يعني القبول والرضا. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمَرْضَاتٌ مِّنَ اللّهِ أَكْبَرُ' (سورة آل عمران: 162). ويعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرمز إلى القيمة العالية للرضا عن الله تعالى.

in_urdu.name: مرضی
in_urdu.meaning: رضا اور قبولیت اللہ تعالیٰ سے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مرضی ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے رضا اور قبولیت اللہ تعالیٰ سے۔ یہ نام 'رضی' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے قبول کرنا اور راضی ہونا۔ قرآن کریم میں اس کا ذکر کئی جگہوں پر آیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ آل عمران میں: 'وَمَرْضَاتٌ مِّنَ اللّهِ أَكْبَرُ' (162)۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ اللہ تعالیٰ کی رضا کی اعلیٰ قدر کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुरथदा
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुरथदा एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है ईश्वर से संतुष्टि और स्वीकृति। यह नाम 'رضی' क्रिया से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है स्वीकार करना और संतुष्ट होना। कुरआन में इसका उल्लेख कई स्थानों पर किया गया है, जैसे कि सूरह آل عمران में: 'وَمَرْضَاتٌ مِّنَ اللّهِ أَكْبَرُ' (162)। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत महत्व रखता है, क्योंकि यह ईश्वर की संतुष्टि की उच्च मूल्य की प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

in_pashto.name: مرθύډا
in_pashto.meaning: الله تعالی څخه رضایت او منلو
in_pashto.long_meaning: مرθύډا یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستی دی. دغه نوم معنی یې ده الله تعالی څخه رضایت او منلو. دا نوم د 'رضی' فعل څخه اخیستی دی چی معنی یې ده منل او راضی کیدل. په قرآن کریم کې دغه نوم په ډیرو ځایونو کې راغلی دی، لکه په سورت آل عمران کې: 'وَمَرْضَاتٌ مِّنَ اللّهِ أَكْبَرُ' (162). دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې ډیر اهمیت لري، ځکه چی د الله تعالی د رضایت لوړه ارزښت نمایندګي کوي.

in_english.name: Murthada
in_english.meaning: Pleasure, satisfaction, and acceptance from Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Murthada is a masculine name of Arabic origin, meaning pleasure, satisfaction, and acceptance from Allah. It is derived from the verb 'رضي' (radhi), which means to be pleased with or to accept. The name is mentioned in the Quran in several places, including Surah Al Imran: 'وَمَرْضَاتٌ مِّنَ اللّهِ أَكْبَرُ' (162). In Islamic tradition, Murthada is considered a highly valued name, symbolizing the importance of being pleased with Allah's will. It reflects a desirable personality trait of being content with one's fate and trusting in divine wisdom.

data.cultural_impact: The name Murthada holds immense cultural significance, as it is a reminder of the virtues of generosity, kindness, and selflessness. In Islamic culture, giving and helping others are highly valued qualities. The name Murthada is a reflection of these values and serves as a continuous motivation for its bearer to be charitable and to extend a helping hand to those in need.
data.spiritual_significance: Murthada is also a spiritually significant name, as it relates to one of the fundamental teachings of Islam - the concept of tawhid, or monotheism. Generosity and selflessness are characteristics of Allah, and by emulating these qualities, the bearer of the name Murthada is reflecting the attributes of the Divine. The spiritual significance of the name also underscores the importance of compassion and caring for others in order to draw closer to Allah and to lead a meaningful and virtuous life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Giver of Generosity" symbolizes One who gives generously and kindly to others. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Murthada serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of giver of generosity.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Murthada is mentioned in the book 'Kitab al-Aghani' as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Murthada carried significant weight in that era.
